title: Profile engram mcp shutdown under realistic load and a large WAL, and name the blocking stage
outcome: Capture MCP shutdown milestones under realistic load with a large WAL and identify the blocking stage.
acceptance: The stage between trace_flush_finished and service_waiting_returned in engram mcp shutdown is identified from the captured milestones, with the blocking wait named in source
A slow shutdown is reproduced under realistic load with a large WAL, and captured milestones identify the blocking stage
